name: TCM NotebookLM Bridge
description: Wraps the nlm CLI (https://pypi.org/project/notebooklm-mcp-cli/) for use from inside OpenClaw. Exposes openclaw tcm nlm ... subcommands. No agent tools (CLI-only).

nlmBin.description: Absolute path to the nlm binary.

dailyQuota.description: Soft daily query quota (informational; the nlm CLI surfaces 429 on hard limit).

spawnTimeoutMs.description: Hard timeout per nlm subprocess call.
